name: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number
semantic_validation: Lookup ClinicalTrials.gov.
edge_cases: NCT is assigned after registration submission; protocol numbers and other registry IDs are separate.

name: CVE ID
canonical_form: CVE-YYYY-sequence of at least four digits
semantic_validation: Lookup CVE record and status; NVD is an enrichment source, not the assigning authority.
edge_cases: Not a federal-government identifier, although NIST NVD tracks it; rejected/reserved records and aliases require lifecycle handling.

name: ERIC accession number
semantic_validation: Lookup ERIC.
edge_cases: ED documents and EJ journal articles use distinct prefixes; not the DOI.

name: NCES local education agency/district ID
semantic_validation: Lookup school-year NCES LEA directory.
edge_cases: Vintage-specific; seven digits are generic without context.

name: NCES school ID
semantic_validation: Lookup school-year NCES directory.
edge_cases: Often constructed from district ID plus school sequence; schools close/reopen and IDs can change. Collides with EPA IDs by shape.

name: EPA Facility Registry Service Registry ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in FRS; crosswalk program-system IDs.
edge_cases: FRS integrates many program IDs; one physical site may have many source-system facility IDs.

name: NPDES permit number
canonical_form: Common form two-letter jurisdiction + seven digits
semantic_validation: Lookup in ECHO/state NPDES data.
edge_cases: General-permit coverage IDs and state systems can add letters/suffixes; common regex is not exhaustive.

name: RCRA Handler ID
canonical_form: 4–12 alphanumeric characters; commonly state/territory prefix + program character + serial
semantic_validation: Lookup in RCRAInfo and validate jurisdiction prefix.
edge_cases: Format/length varies; NN is used in some federal/non-state contexts. Do not infer a facility identity across program IDs without FRS crosswalk.

name: EPA Risk Management Plan facility ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in RMP data.
edge_cases: Same length as FRS Registry ID; program context required and sensitive facility details may be restricted.

name: TRI Facility ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in TRI data.
edge_cases: No safe universal grammar; often derived from location/name history and may change after facility changes.

name: U.S. aircraft registration N‑number
canonical_form: N + 1–5 characters under FAA digit/letter rules
semantic_validation: Apply FAA formation rules and registry lookup.
edge_cases: Letters I and O are prohibited; first digit cannot be zero; N1–N99 are reserved for FAA internal use; historical NC/NX/NR/NL markings are display categories, not modern base N-number grammar.

name: FCC docket number
examples: WC Docket No. 19-195 | GN Docket No. 23-65 | ET Docket No. 24-1 | RM-12345
semantic_validation: Lookup in ECFS and update docket-prefix list.
edge_cases: Several dockets can be joined in one proceeding; older CC/MM/PR and other series exist.

name: FCC broadcast Facility ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in FCC LMS/CDBS facility data.
edge_cases: Bare number is unusable without Facility ID/broadcast context; call signs can change while facility ID persists.

name: FCC Registration Number (FRN)
semantic_validation: Lookup in FCC CORES where permitted.
edge_cases: Ten digits collide with NPI/CIK/FEI; FRN can be associated with sensitive registration data.

name: FCC equipment authorization ID
canonical_form: Grantee code + product code, commonly printed with optional hyphen
normalization: Uppercase; preserve/display grantee-product boundary from FCC registry.
semantic_validation: Lookup in FCC equipment authorization database; validate grantee code.
edge_cases: The grantee-code length rules changed; no-space labels and logos complicate OCR. Broad regex has extreme collision risk.

name: FEC candidate ID
canonical_form: Nine uppercase alphanumeric characters beginning H, S, or P
semantic_validation: Lookup in FEC candidate data and validate office/state/district semantics.
edge_cases: Presidential IDs have different internal semantics from House/Senate IDs; election-cycle digit does not alone establish candidate identity over time.

name: FEC committee ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in FEC committee data.
edge_cases: Committees can terminate, change names or be affiliated; ID persists in filings.

name: FEMA declaration/document display variant
normalization: Normalize to type-number and link state/date from registry.
semantic_validation: Lookup FEMA declarations.
edge_cases: Same object as DR-####-ST style, not a second identifier; state may be omitted.

name: FEMA disaster declaration number
semantic_validation: Lookup FEMA declarations and incident type/state.
edge_cases: Public declaration ID can be printed as FEMA-####-DR, DR-####-ST, or just ####; Regulations.gov docket IDs such as FEMA-2022-0001 are unrelated.

name: FERC eLibrary accession number
semantic_validation: Validate date and lookup in eLibrary.
edge_cases: Accession date can be filing/processing-related; not the docket number.

name: FERC docket/subdocket number
canonical_form: Proceeding-type prefix + two-digit year + serial + optional three-digit subdocket
semantic_validation: Lookup in FERC eLibrary and validate docket-type code.
edge_cases: Subdocket suffix is significant; letter prefixes vary widely and historical proceedings have other formats.

name: FERC order/opinion number
semantic_validation: Lookup FERC order/opinion index.
edge_cases: Lettered rehearing/revision is part of the cited instrument; one order may span many dockets.

name: FMCSA operating-authority docket number
semantic_validation: Lookup in FMCSA Licensing & Insurance; retain while active/historical.
edge_cases: FMCSA has proposed moving to USDOT-based identifiers, but MC/FF/MX numbers remain necessary for historical/current records until authoritative retirement.

name: USDOT number
normalization: Store integer plus displayed digits; do not invent padding.
semantic_validation: Lookup in SAFER/FMCSA.
edge_cases: Historical length grows over time; proposed modernization adds registration-type suffix letters, but unsuffixed numeric USDOT remains the established public identifier until final implementation data says otherwise.

name: Proposed FMCSA USDOT registration-type suffix
canonical_form: USDOT number + one or more controlled suffix letters
normalization: Uppercase suffix; split base USDOT and type codes.
semantic_validation: Apply only when FMCSA final rules/system documentation show the suffix is operational; validate code combination.
edge_cases: As of the 2026 proposal/modernization materials, suffix adoption and legacy MC-number phaseout are not universal final-state assumptions.

name: Core Based Statistical Area code
issuer: Office of Management and Budget / Census Bureau
semantic_validation: Lookup OMB delineation/vintage.
edge_cases: Same shape as ZIP/FIPS combined codes; area composition and code can change with OMB delineations.

name: Census block GEOID
canonical_form: 2 state + 3 county + 6 tract + 1 block group + 3 block digits
semantic_validation: Lookup census vintage.
edge_cases: Block identity is vintage-specific; redistricting/decennial products can expose related variants.

name: Census block group GEOID
semantic_validation: Lookup census vintage.
edge_cases: Same shape as EPA 12-digit IDs; field/context required.

name: Census place GEOID
semantic_validation: Lookup geography vintage.
edge_cases: Place code can be compared only within state/vintage; seven digits collide with school/agency IDs.

name: Census tract GEOID
normalization: Preserve leading zeros and implied tract decimal.
semantic_validation: Lookup census vintage/geography.
edge_cases: Tract codes can contain implied decimal; boundaries/codes change by decennial vintage.

name: FIPS/ANSI county code
canonical_form: Three digits, unique only within state
semantic_validation: Lookup with state code and vintage.
edge_cases: County code alone is not national; independent cities/territories and reorganizations create edge cases.

name: FIPS/ANSI state code
semantic_validation: Lookup edition/current ANSI code list.
edge_cases: Two digits alone are never self-identifying; historical codes/status changes require effective dates.

name: Combined state-county FIPS code
semantic_validation: Split 2+3 and lookup vintage.
edge_cases: Same five-digit shape as ZIP/ZCTA/CBSA and other geography codes; field semantics are mandatory.

name: GNIS Feature ID
issuer: U.S. Geological Survey / U.S. Board on Geographic Names
semantic_validation: Lookup GNIS; require field/URL when unlabeled.
edge_cases: Names and coordinates can change while Feature ID persists; numeric shape is generic.

name: Originating Agency Identifier (ORI)
semantic_validation: Exact lookup in NCIC/authorized ORI tables; apply dissemination restrictions.
edge_cases: State-prefix convention has exceptions for federal/tribal/international agencies; not all ORI directories are public. Shape collides with many IDs.

name: FERC reporter citation
semantic_validation: Resolve to FERC order/decision.
edge_cases: Division 61/62 and reporter conventions matter; citation is distinct from docket/accession/order number.

name: NARA accession number
semantic_validation: Validate in accession/catalog records.
edge_cases: Legacy accession systems use several prefixes and component lengths; broad regex is not exhaustive.

name: NARA local identifier
canonical_form: Creator/unit-specific text, up to catalog field limits
normalization: Preserve exact raw and archival unit.
semantic_validation: Validate from NARA Catalog metadata.
edge_cases: No universal grammar; local IDs are only unique within the creating/cataloging unit and can contain punctuation/spaces.

name: National Archives Identifier (NAID)
normalization: Store integer; retain labeled raw form.
semantic_validation: Lookup in National Archives Catalog.
edge_cases: Bare numeric value is unusable without NAID field/URL. A description can cover a series/file/item and may have digital-object children.

name: NARA Record Group number
semantic_validation: Lookup NARA record-group authority data.
edge_cases: Not an item identifier; record groups contain many series/accessions and organizational history.

name: NHTSA recall campaign number
canonical_form: Two-digit year + category letter + six digits
semantic_validation: Lookup NHTSA recalls API; validate category.
edge_cases: Manufacturer campaign numbers are separate and agency category letters differ for vehicles/equipment/tires/child seats.

name: NIH grant/application/award number
canonical_form: Application type + activity code + institute/center + six-digit serial + support year + suffixes
normalization: Remove spaces; uppercase; parse all components.
semantic_validation: Validate activity/IC codes, serial and suffix semantics against NIH RePORTER/award data.
edge_cases: Application type, support year, amendment A#, supplement S# and fellowship identifiers are components; compact numbers omit some fields. Other HHS agencies reuse NIH-style grant numbers.

name: FIPS publication identifier
issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
semantic_validation: Lookup NIST publication and withdrawal/supersession status.
edge_cases: FIPS number/revision is a publication identifier, not a compliant-product certificate.

name: NIST Interagency/Internal Report identifier
issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
semantic_validation: Lookup NIST publication.
edge_cases: Letter suffix can denote a distinct report in a series, not merely a revision.

name: NIST Special Publication identifier
issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology
examples: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 | SP 800-171A Rev. 3 | NIST SP 1800-1
semantic_validation: Lookup NIST publication version/supersession.
uniqueness_key_scope: NIST SP series + number + part + revision
edge_cases: Parts, appendices and update errata are version locators; citation without revision can be ambiguous.

name: OSHA inspection/activity number
semantic_validation: Validate in OSHA establishment/inspection data.
edge_cases: Legacy IMIS and newer systems expose differing display forms; numeric shape alone is not reliable.

name: Data.gov/agency dataset identifier
normalization: Preserve source catalog URL, platform ID and source-system ID separately.
semantic_validation: Validate through catalog API.
edge_cases: Data.gov aggregates catalogs; a CKAN UUID/slug is not necessarily the source agency's durable identifier and migrations can change it.

name: PubMed Central ID (PMCID)
semantic_validation: Lookup PMC and crosswalk to PMID/DOI.
edge_cases: PMCID identifies full-text archive object and is not interchangeable with PMID.

name: PubMed ID (PMID)
semantic_validation: Lookup PubMed.
edge_cases: Bare digits are unusable; corrections/versions are linked records, not embedded in PMID.

name: FOIA request/tracking number (generic open class)
normalization: Preserve raw, agency/component and received date.
semantic_validation: Validate in the issuing agency's FOIA portal/log.
edge_cases: No government-wide grammar; agencies migrate portals and can expose separate request, appeal, referral and case numbers.

name: Digital Object Identifier (DOI)
normalization: Strip doi: or resolver URL; preserve suffix case for round-trip, use case-folded lookup alias.
semantic_validation: Resolve through DOI registry; candidate regex is intentionally conservative.
edge_cases: The DOI specification permits a broader suffix character space than most regexes; trailing punctuation/parentheses require balanced parsing. DOI is not federal-issued.

name: SEC EDGAR accession number
canonical_form: 10-digit submitting CIK + two-digit year + six-digit sequence
normalization: Canonical display NNNNNNNNNN-YY-NNNNNN; filenames often remove hyphens.
semantic_validation: Validate accession in EDGAR; first ten digits identify submitter, not always subject company.
edge_cases: One filing can contain many documents; amendments have separate accession numbers and form types.

name: SEC EDGAR CIK Confirmation Code (CCC)
canonical_form: Eight case-sensitive characters with SEC composition rules
semantic_validation: Validate only in authenticated EDGAR filing workflow.
edge_cases: Secret credential, not a public identifier. Do not extract into search indexes or knowledge graphs.

name: SEC Central Index Key (CIK)
canonical_form: Numeric identifier up to ten digits; EDGAR often zero-pads to ten
normalization: Store numeric value plus ten-digit zero-padded display alias.
semantic_validation: Lookup in EDGAR company data.
edge_cases: Leading zeros are formatting, not a different filer; bare digits collide widely. A filer can change names/tickers without changing CIK.

name: SEC file number
normalization: Uppercase letter prefixes; preserve zero padding.
semantic_validation: Interpret/validate by SEC form/release/program.
edge_cases: No single SEC file-number grammar: company registration, Securities Act, administrative proceedings and rulemaking use different series.

name: SEC release number
semantic_validation: Lookup SEC releases; update controlled series list.
edge_cases: A release may also carry file number, administrative proceeding number and Federal Register document number.

name: Item Unique Identification / Unique Item Identifier (IUID/UII)
canonical_form: Concatenated enterprise identifier, serial and sometimes part/lot components
normalization: Preserve data qualifiers and issuer/enterprise-ID type.
semantic_validation: Validate according to MIL-STD-130/IUID construct and registry.
edge_cases: No single regex: CAGE/DUNS/DoDAAC enterprise IDs, serials and part/lot values create multiple constructs; data-matrix encoding includes identifiers/qualifiers.

name: MILSTRIP document number
canonical_form: Six-character DoDAAC + one-digit year + three-digit Julian day + four-character serial
semantic_validation: Validate DoDAAC, Julian date and transaction context.
edge_cases: One-digit year requires decade inference from context; supplementary address/suffix fields may be printed adjacent.

name: National Item Identification Number (NIIN)
issuer: Defense Logistics Agency / NATO codification system
canonical_form: Nine digits: two-digit codification bureau + seven-digit item number
semantic_validation: Lookup in FLIS; distinguish from SSN and other nine-digit values.
edge_cases: NIIN is not the full NSN because it omits Federal Supply Class.

name: National Stock Number (NSN)
issuer: Defense Logistics Agency / NATO codification system
canonical_form: Four-digit FSC + nine-digit NIIN; 13 digits total
semantic_validation: Lookup in FLIS/WebFLIS and validate country/codification bureau segment.
edge_cases: NIIN is the final nine digits and can be cited alone; legacy Federal Stock Numbers predate NSN.

name: U.S. Coast Guard official vessel number
issuer: U.S. Coast Guard National Vessel Documentation Center
canonical_form: Permanent six- or seven-digit official number (common modern/historical)
semantic_validation: Lookup documented-vessel registry.
edge_cases: Not the state registration number, IMO number, MMSI or hull identification number; bare digits collide heavily.

name: U.S. patent application number
canonical_form: Two-digit application series + slash + six-digit serial
normalization: Remove comma from serial; preserve slash.
semantic_validation: Validate in Patent Center; include filing date/type.
edge_cases: Provisional, reissue, design, plant and PCT national-stage records share/relate to application number systems; unpublished applications can be confidential.

name: U.S. patent number
canonical_form: Utility numeric or patent-type prefix + serial
semantic_validation: Lookup in USPTO Patent Center/search and validate patent type.
edge_cases: Bare utility numbers collide with ordinary numbers; early X patents and defensive/statutory series need historical handling. Kind codes belong to publications, not issued patent identity.

name: PTAB AIA trial proceeding number
issuer: USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board
semantic_validation: Lookup in PTAB End-to-End.
edge_cases: CBM program sunset but historical dockets remain; institution/appeal papers have document numbers scoped to proceeding.

name: U.S. patent application publication number
canonical_form: US + YYYY + seven-digit publication serial + kind code
semantic_validation: Validate publication/kind code in USPTO data.
edge_cases: Publication number is not the application serial number or issued patent number; republications/corrections use different kind codes.

name: U.S. trademark registration number
canonical_form: Numeric registration serial of variable historical length
normalization: Remove commas; preserve source zero padding.
semantic_validation: Lookup in TSDR.
edge_cases: Not the application serial number; old registrations have fewer digits and can be cancelled/renewed.

name: U.S. trademark application serial number
semantic_validation: Lookup in USPTO TSDR; use filing basis/series metadata.
edge_cases: The first two digits denote serial-number series; the 50 series began in 2026 and 79 is associated with Madrid filings. Bare eight digits collide widely.

name: ASBCA appeal number
issuer: Armed Services Board of Contract Appeals
semantic_validation: Validate in ASBCA decision search.
edge_cases: A decision can dispose of multiple appeal numbers; contract number is a separate PIID.

name: Board of Veterans' Appeals citation number
canonical_form: Eight-digit publication citation number under explicit label
semantic_validation: Resolve in VA BVA decision search.
edge_cases: Not the veteran's claim/file number or Board docket number; person-linked decisions are redacted.

name: Board of Veterans' Appeals docket number
normalization: Collapse repeated whitespace but preserve punctuation; retain raw.
semantic_validation: Validate in source decision/VA system.
edge_cases: Legacy dockets contain spaces; modernized appeal systems use different structures. Do not confuse with citation number.

name: CBCA case/appeal number
semantic_validation: Validate in CBCA docket/decisions.
edge_cases: Case categories can be conveyed separately; not globally unique without CBCA namespace.

name: EEOC federal-sector appeal number
canonical_form: Ten-digit appeal/request number under explicit label
semantic_validation: Validate in EEOC federal-sector decisions.
edge_cases: Appeal and request-for-reconsideration numbers can share shape; bare ten digits collide widely.

name: FLRA case number
semantic_validation: Validate type/number in FLRA decision records; update controlled type list.
edge_cases: Prefix list is observed and may not be exhaustive historically.

name: MSPB docket number
canonical_form: Regional office - action/legal code - FY/year - serial - case suffix - iteration
semantic_validation: Validate every code segment against MSPB tables and docket search.
edge_cases: Legal/action and case-stage codes are controlled lists; mixed/historical formats occur. Regex only finds candidates.

name: NLRB case number
semantic_validation: Validate region/type/serial in NLRB case search.
edge_cases: Case-type code list is extensive and changes; multiple related cases can be consolidated.

name: OCAHO case number
issuer: DOJ Office of the Chief Administrative Hearing Officer
semantic_validation: Validate in OCAHO decision index.
edge_cases: Several historical grammars coexist; a permissive regex should be gated by OCAHO context.

name: OCAHO decision reference number
canonical_form: Sequential decision reference with optional letter suffix
semantic_validation: Require OCAHO decision-reference field and validate in index.
edge_cases: Extremely generic without context; introduced/used as a publication reference rather than the case docket.

name: U.S. court of appeals docket number
normalization: Normalize No. label and dash; preserve leading zeros.
semantic_validation: Court identity is mandatory; validate in circuit docket/PACER.
edge_cases: Consolidated/cross-appeals list multiple numbers; agency petitions and original proceedings share the shape; SCOTUS regular dockets overlap.

name: Bankruptcy adversary proceeding number
normalization: Preserve raw; explicitly tag adversary type.
semantic_validation: Validate in bankruptcy CM/ECF and link parent bankruptcy case when available.
edge_cases: When 'ap' is omitted, the number can be indistinguishable from the parent bankruptcy docket without page/context metadata.

name: U.S. bankruptcy court case number
semantic_validation: Require bankruptcy court identity and PACER validation.
edge_cases: Many courts omit 'bk'; lexical shape then collides with appeals, tax and other dockets. Joint/admin-consolidated cases have related numbers.

name: Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces docket number
issuer: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces
semantic_validation: Validate in CAAF docket.
edge_cases: Service suffix is integral; OT and future codes require list maintenance.

name: Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims docket number
issuer: U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims
canonical_form: YY-serial; optional court annotation or consolidated list
normalization: Uppercase annotation; split slash-separated consolidated dockets.
semantic_validation: Validate in CAVC docket.
edge_cases: Consent/consolidation lists and annotations are not always part of canonical base docket.

name: Court of Federal Claims case number
semantic_validation: Validate in CFC docket; interpret suffix from court rules/system.
edge_cases: V commonly marks vaccine cases; C/L/T and other suffixes reflect categories. Suffix is part of identity.

name: Court of International Trade case number
semantic_validation: Validate in CIT docket/case search.
edge_cases: Lexically overlaps other court/agency dockets; older/historical formats may differ.

name: Court of International Trade slip opinion number
canonical_form: YY-serial or YYYY-serial with Slip Op. label
normalization: Normalize year to four digits using publication date; preserve raw.
semantic_validation: Validate against CIT opinions list.
edge_cases: Not the case docket number; multiple opinions can issue in one case.

name: U.S. district court CM/ECF case number
normalization: Normalize separators only into parsed fields; preserve court display string and zero padding.
semantic_validation: Court identity is mandatory; validate against PACER/CM-ECF/local court.
edge_cases: Office/division prefix, judge initials, reassignment suffixes and local case-type codes vary. The same short docket can exist in many courts.

name: CM/ECF docket-entry/document number
canonical_form: Integer docket entry; optional attachment suffix
semantic_validation: Resolve within court case docket.
edge_cases: Docket-entry numbers restart in every case; attachment 123-1 is not case 123-1. Sealed/restricted entries may be absent or renumbered in exports.

name: Federal Circuit appeal number
issuer: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
semantic_validation: Validate in Federal Circuit docket/opinion data.
edge_cases: Different from the two-digit docket style of regional circuits; agency case numbers may be cross-referenced.

name: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court docket identifier
normalization: Uppercase controlled prefix; preserve legal subsection punctuation.
semantic_validation: Validate against public filing index.
edge_cases: Only a public subset is visible; prefix set is not necessarily exhaustive and classified matters may never be published.

name: JPML multicircuit petition number
semantic_validation: Validate with JPML.
edge_cases: Distinct from MDL; relatively uncommon.

name: Judicial Panel on Multidistrict Litigation MDL number
semantic_validation: Validate in JPML docket list; link constituent district case numbers.
edge_cases: MDL number identifies centralized proceeding, not every transferred civil action; district docket may include 'md'.

name: PACER/CM‑ECF court identifier
issuer: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
semantic_validation: Lookup PACER court list; maintain active/legacy aliases.
edge_cases: Codes are platform identifiers, not official court names; appellate/district/bankruptcy codes can follow different conventions.

name: Supreme Court emergency/application docket number
issuer: Supreme Court of the United States
semantic_validation: Validate in Supreme Court docket/application search.
edge_cases: Applications can later relate to a merits docket but retain their own A-number.

name: Supreme Court merits/petition docket number
issuer: Supreme Court of the United States
semantic_validation: Validate in Supreme Court docket search and distinguish application/original dockets.
edge_cases: Shape overlaps circuit dockets; docket prefix generally reflects Term, not filing calendar year in all circumstances.

name: Supreme Court original-jurisdiction docket number
issuer: Supreme Court of the United States
normalization: Uppercase letter O; never normalize to zero.
semantic_validation: Validate in Supreme Court docket.
edge_cases: OCR commonly confuses O with 0; original cases can remain open across Terms.

name: Military service Court of Criminal Appeals docket identifier
semantic_validation: Use service court docket/opinion index.
edge_cases: No single inter-service grammar: summary/regular/miscellaneous cases use different prefixes, bare serials and year-number forms; rehearing annotations are not base IDs.

name: U.S. Tax Court docket number
semantic_validation: Validate in DAWSON; interpret suffix using current Tax Court docket types.
edge_cases: Suffixes distinguish small-tax, lien/levy, passport and other proceedings; combinations such as SL must be matched before S/L.

name: GovInfo U.S. Courts opinion granule ID
semantic_validation: Resolve within package granule list.
edge_cases: Trailing sequence is publication granule order, not necessarily ECF document number.

name: GovInfo U.S. Courts opinion package ID
canonical_form: USCOURTS-{court code}-{case number with colons encoded as underscores}
normalization: Preserve court code; decode underscores to colons only with GovInfo metadata.
semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo package and compare court/case metadata.
edge_cases: Court-local case numbering remains underneath; underscores can represent colons, and short display numbers may omit office/type/zero padding.

name: Bankruptcy Reporter citation
semantic_validation: Resolve reporter/court/date.
edge_cases: B.R. can be textually ambiguous without legal context; docket and court remain separate identifiers.

name: American case citation (generic parsed object)
canonical_form: Full, short, supra, id., neutral and parallel citation structures
normalization: Use a legal citation parser; preserve spans and antecedent relations.
semantic_validation: Resolve against reporter database and court/opinion corpus; regex alone is insufficient.
edge_cases: Reporter ambiguity, nominative reports, parallel citations, pin cites, short forms, id./supra, OCR and HTML boundaries require stateful parsing.

name: Federal Appendix citation
semantic_validation: Resolve through reporter database.
edge_cases: Apostrophe/typographic/OCR variants are common; series publication ended but historical citations persist.

name: Federal Claims/Court of Claims reporter citation
normalization: Normalize reporter and distinguish Fed. Cl. from Ct. Cl.
semantic_validation: Resolve reporter date/court.
edge_cases: Historical court reorganizations make reporter/date important.

name: Federal Reporter citation
semantic_validation: Resolve reporter edition/date/court using reporter database.
edge_cases: Reporter abbreviations have OCR/spacing variants; unpublished opinions may instead use F. App'x or electronic cites.

name: Federal Supplement citation
semantic_validation: Resolve through reporter database.
edge_cases: District court orders often have no reporter cite; vendor electronic cites and slip dockets are common.

name: FLRA decision citation
canonical_form: Volume FLRA page or No. decision
semantic_validation: Resolve through FLRA decisions; distinguish page and numbered online forms.
edge_cases: Citation is publication locator, not underlying case docket; one decision can address multiple cases.

name: NLRB decision citation
semantic_validation: Resolve decision and docket crosswalk.
edge_cases: Online decision number and bound-volume page styles coexist.

name: Supreme Court Reporter citation
semantic_validation: Resolve with reporter database; treat as secondary/vendor citation.
edge_cases: Not a government-issued identifier; parallel to U.S. Reports/L. Ed.

name: Tax Court reporter citation
normalization: Normalize T.C.; handle memorandum reporters with reporter database.
semantic_validation: Resolve against Tax Court opinion data.
edge_cases: T.C., T.C. Memo., T.C.M. and summary opinions are distinct publication families.

name: United States Reports citation
issuer: Supreme Court of the United States / GPO
semantic_validation: Resolve volume/page and distinguish pin cites.
edge_cases: Early nominative reports have parallel citations; slip opinions initially lack final U.S. Reports pagination.

name: Veterans Appeals Reporter citation
issuer: U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims / publisher
semantic_validation: Resolve through reporter/court data.
edge_cases: Distinct from Board of Veterans' Appeals citation numbers.

name: DEA registration number
canonical_form: Common current/legacy form: two letters + seven digits, final checksum digit
semantic_validation: Apply DEA checksum candidate test and authoritative registration verification; account for business/organizational registrants.
edge_cases: Second letter historically related to registrant name but should not be treated as a hard validator; registrant-type prefixes evolve. Sensitive professional credential.

name: PIV Card UUID
canonical_form: RFC 4122-style UUID stored in PIV card data
semantic_validation: Require PIV credential context; validate certificate/card data.
edge_cases: Generic UUID collision: never classify a UUID as PIV from shape alone. Card UUID can change on replacement.

name: PIV FASC‑N
canonical_form: Structured Federal Agency Smart Credential Number fields
semantic_validation: Validate field-level encoding and issuer.
edge_cases: FIPS 201-3 discourages relying on FASC-N as the sole identifier; uniqueness is not universal outside the Executive Branch/PIV-I, and replacement/reissuance matters.

name: 510(k) premarket notification number
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA 510(k) database.
edge_cases: The first two digits commonly encode year but century/history requires database logic; K-number is not a product model number.

name: FDA drug/biologic application number
canonical_form: Application-type label + generally six-digit application number
semantic_validation: Lookup Drugs@FDA/biologics application data.
edge_cases: Application number alone can collide across types; BLA numbering and legacy records have historical nuances. Product numbers/supplements are separate.

name: De Novo classification request number
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA De Novo database.
edge_cases: Older records and decision numbers may appear with spaces/punctuation; do not confuse with docket IDs.

name: FDA Establishment Identifier (FEI)
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA establishment data/authorized system.
edge_cases: Ten-digit shape collides with NPI/phone/other IDs; FEI is facility-linked and may not be publicly resolvable in every program.

name: Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) number
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA HDE/PMA data.
edge_cases: Generic H+digits collision; HDE and HUD designations are different objects.

name: Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) number
semantic_validation: Validate in FDA/device records where public.
edge_cases: Generic G+digits collision; some IDE information is confidential.

name: Investigational New Drug (IND) number
canonical_form: IND + five/six-digit number, often displayed six digits
semantic_validation: Validate in FDA/sponsor records; many IND records are confidential.
edge_cases: Not all INDs/public references are searchable; context and disclosure restrictions matter.

name: Premarket Approval (PMA) number
canonical_form: P + six digits; optional /S + three-digit supplement
normalization: Uppercase P/S; preserve slash and zero padding.
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA PMA database; distinguish original and supplements.
edge_cases: Supplement number is scoped to base PMA; amendments/panel-track supplements may have related labels.

name: CLIA laboratory number
canonical_form: Ten-character alphanumeric; common form two digits + letter + seven digits
semantic_validation: Lookup in CMS CLIA/QCOR data.
edge_cases: Official descriptions emphasize 10 alphanumeric characters; common D-position form should be treated as a strong candidate, not a timeless exhaustive grammar.

name: CMS Certification Number (CCN/provider number)
canonical_form: Six-character legacy/current provider identifier with provider-type/state semantics
semantic_validation: Lookup provider-specific CMS datasets and provider type.
edge_cases: Format varies by facility/provider type and special units; formerly called OSCAR provider number. Not interchangeable with NPI.

name: Health Insurance Claim Number (HICN)
canonical_form: Legacy beneficiary/claim number with multiple SSA/RRB formats
normalization: Preserve raw and classify subtype; never coerce into SSN.
semantic_validation: Use CMS historical format tables and privacy safeguards.
edge_cases: Often SSN-derived with Beneficiary Identification Code, but RRB and other forms differ. Replaced by MBI and remains highly sensitive in historical data.

name: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI)
canonical_form: 11 characters with fixed numeric/alphabetic/alphanumeric positions; excludes B, I, L, O, S, Z
semantic_validation: Apply positional alphabet restrictions; no public checksum/issuance validation.
edge_cases: Display commonly uses 4-3-4 grouping; letters excluded to avoid ambiguity. Highly sensitive beneficiary identifier.

name: National patient identifier
canonical_form: No implemented federal universal patient ID
semantic_validation: Use program/provider-specific identifiers subject to law and privacy policy.
edge_cases: Do not mislabel MRNs, MBIs, HICNs, SSNs or insurer member IDs as a national patient identifier.

name: NDC—HIPAA 11-digit billing format
canonical_form: Five-digit labeler + four-digit product + two-digit package, created by padding native NDC segment
normalization: Store 5-4-2 segments and retain source native NDC mapping.
semantic_validation: Validate reversible mapping to an FDA-listed native NDC; multiple native segmentations make padding provenance essential.
edge_cases: An 11-digit billing NDC is not necessarily the printed FDA 10-digit NDC; dropping the padding without segment metadata can map incorrectly.

name: National Drug Code—native 10-digit labeler format
normalization: Preserve segment lengths; do not merely remove hyphens because segmentation is semantic.
semantic_validation: Lookup FDA NDC Directory; validate labeler/product/package segments and marketing status.
edge_cases: Unhyphenated 10 digits are ambiguous among the three segmentations. This format remains current through the FDA transition period.

name: NDC—future uniform 12-digit format
canonical_form: Six-digit labeler + four-digit product + two-digit package
semantic_validation: Apply only with effective-date/version context and FDA directory lookup.
edge_cases: FDA's uniform 12-digit format becomes effective March 7, 2033; transition/labeling dates span multiple years. Do not accept it as a current NDC merely by shape before effective data says so.

name: National Provider Identifier (NPI)
canonical_form: Ten digits with ISO/IEC 7812 Luhn check using 80840 prefix
semantic_validation: Apply NPI Luhn validation and lookup NPPES.
edge_cases: Ten digits collide with many IDs; an NPI identifies a provider/entity, not licensure or specialty.

name: Alien Registration Number / A‑Number
canonical_form: A prefix plus historically 7–9 digits; many current systems canonicalize to nine digits
normalization: Remove A and separators for canonical numeric value; left-pad older 7/8-digit values to nine only when the target system specifies.
semantic_validation: Require immigration context; verify against source record.
edge_cases: ICE locator expects nine digits and leading zeros for older numbers; some USCIS interfaces/documentation expose inconsistent 9/10-digit guidance. Bare nine digits collide with SSN and other IDs.

name: Form I‑94 admission number
canonical_form: Historical 11 digits; modern 9 digits + letter + digit
semantic_validation: Require I-94/CBP context and authorized lookup.
edge_cases: Modern alphanumeric transition coexists with older all-numeric records; bare numeric form collides broadly.

name: National Visa Center / immigrant visa case number
canonical_form: Post/center prefix + year/serial digits; common form three letters + ten digits
semantic_validation: Validate prefix/post and case in State Department workflow.
edge_cases: NVC, KCC, SIV and consular-post prefixes differ; transfer can produce cross-references; the broad shape is not universal for every visa workflow.

name: SEVIS ID
semantic_validation: Require SEVIS/I-20/DS-2019 context and authorized verification.
edge_cases: No checksum; generic N+digits can collide. Treat format as an operational candidate rather than proof.

name: USCIS receipt number
semantic_validation: Validate prefix against effective USCIS code list and check case-status service.
edge_cases: Common prefixes include EAC, WAC, LIN, SRC, MSC, NBC and IOE; printed notices may add asterisks/spaces; prefix meanings and electronic workflows evolve.

name: BOP register number
semantic_validation: Lookup BOP inmate locator and confirm identity.
edge_cases: Publicly searchable but still person-linked; may be called inmate/register number. Historical federal prisoners can have other systems/records.

name: Office of the Pardon Attorney clemency case number
canonical_form: P or C + six digits (observed public case lists)
semantic_validation: Verify against DOJ clemency data.
edge_cases: Letter semantics and historical formats can vary; person-linked and context-sensitive.

name: DHS TRIP redress control number
semantic_validation: Validate only through DHS TRIP/travel workflow.
edge_cases: Public sources do not define a reliable universal regex; do not conflate with a Known Traveler Number.

name: Known Traveler Number / PASS ID
canonical_form: Program-issued value; format varies by source/program era
semantic_validation: Validate in trusted-traveler workflow.
edge_cases: KTN/PASS ID/DoD ID inputs are operationally accepted in different contexts; no single safe public regex should be used for all.

name: Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number (ATIN)
canonical_form: Nine digits beginning 9 with middle pair 93
semantic_validation: Require ATIN/adoption tax context.
edge_cases: Same broad nine-digit family as SSN/ITIN; temporary and privacy-sensitive.

name: Employer Identification Number (EIN)
canonical_form: Two digits + seven digits, normally hyphenated 2-7
semantic_validation: Validate prefix against IRS assignment table and corroborate entity/context.
edge_cases: Unhyphenated form collides with SSN/ITIN/DUNS; not all two-digit prefixes are currently valid.

name: Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN)
normalization: Preserve leading zeros; do not log.
required_context: Only explicit IP PIN fields; redact immediately.
semantic_validation: Never validate by regex; treat as secret and redact.
edge_cases: Changes annually and is not a durable person identifier. Six-digit collision is universal.

name: Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)
canonical_form: Nine digits starting 9; middle pair in IRS-assigned ITIN ranges
semantic_validation: Validate middle range and IRS context; issuance/status cannot be confirmed by checksum.
edge_cases: ITIN resembles an SSN but is a distinct namespace; expired ITINs remain historical identifiers.

name: Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN)
semantic_validation: Lookup/verify through IRS PTIN system where authorized.
edge_cases: Legacy PTIN formats used an S prefix before modern reissuance; PTIN is personal credential data.

name: Social Security Number (SSN)
normalization: Remove spaces/hyphens/dots; never expose normalized value unnecessarily.
required_context: SSN/TIN/tax/person context; suppress in public outputs.
semantic_validation: Reject area 000, 666, and 900–999; group 00; serial 0000; apply privacy controls and source verification.
edge_cases: Randomization ended geographic meaning. Masked forms such as XXX-XX-6789 are references, not full SSNs. Many PII libraries use permissive candidate regexes and miss some invalid ranges.

name: Masked SSN / last four digits
normalization: Store only as partial value with mask metadata.
semantic_validation: Never equate last-four values across people without corroboration.
edge_cases: Not a globally unique identifier; common collision and re-identification risk.

name: Taxpayer Identification Number (generic class)
canonical_form: A type umbrella, not one grammar
semantic_validation: Apply subtype-specific validation and privacy policy.
edge_cases: TIN is not synonymous with SSN; forms may accept several namespaces and masked values.

name: Passport application locator number
semantic_validation: Require application-status context and authorized lookup.
edge_cases: Not a passport number; generic numeric collision and high privacy risk.

name: U.S. passport number (current-generation common form)
semantic_validation: Require passport context and document inspection/issuer verification.
edge_cases: Older U.S. passports used numeric and other formats; foreign passports use different grammars. Do not infer nationality from shape.

name: U.S. passport number (legacy/open family)
semantic_validation: Require issue date/passport context; registry-free public validation is unavailable.
uniqueness_key_scope: issuing country + issue era + passport number
edge_cases: A broad nine-character regex has severe collisions. Treat current letter+8 and older numeric records as dated profiles, not one timeless grammar.

name: Congress.gov amendment compound key
normalization: Lowercase in URL; store controlled uppercase type.
semantic_validation: SUAMDT is historical; validate route against API.
edge_cases: Not a human citation.

name: Congressional amendment citation
normalization: Normalize type to HAMDT, SAMDT, or historical SUAMDT.
semantic_validation: Pair with Congress and validate type/number in Congress.gov.
edge_cases: Amendment numbers restart by Congress; SUAMDT appears only in limited historical coverage; chamber amendments printed inside bill text may have local numbers not Congress.gov IDs.

name: Congress.gov bill compound key
normalization: Lowercase API path type; map to uppercase controlled code for storage.
semantic_validation: Validate each component and dereference Congress.gov API.
edge_cases: Not a printed citation; do not merge with a bare bill number without Congress.

name: House concurrent resolution
canonical_form: HCONRES + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
examples: H. Con. Res. 12 | H. Con. Res. 12
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to HCONRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

name: House joint resolution
canonical_form: HJRES + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to HJRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

canonical_form: HR + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to HR; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to HRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

canonical_form: S + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to S; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

name: Senate concurrent resolution
canonical_form: SCONRES + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
examples: S. Con. Res. 12 | S. Con. Res. 12
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to SCONRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

canonical_form: SJRES + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to SJRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

canonical_form: SRES + number; Congress is a mandatory namespace component
normalization: Remove periods/space in type and uppercase to SRES; keep the printed form as raw.
required_context: Congress/date/document collection is required for identity.
semantic_validation: Validate type against the eight Congress.gov bill types and resolve using Congress number.
edge_cases: Numbers restart each Congress; S. is highly ambiguous without legislative context; OCR often drops periods or inserts nonbreaking spaces.

name: Bill text version code
canonical_form: Lowercase controlled code attached to a bill text
examples: ih | is | rh | rs | enr | eah | eas | pcs
required_context: Only parse inside Congress/GovInfo bill text metadata.
semantic_validation: Must be looked up in the current/historical bill-version code list; regex alone is meaningless.
edge_cases: House and Senate use overlapping codes; codes are not globally unique and historical values exist.

name: Committee print citation/print number
canonical_form: Printed label plus Congress-local print number
semantic_validation: Prefer GovInfo package/Jacket ID; printed numbering is not uniform across all committees.
edge_cases: Some prints use a GPO jacket ID rather than a simple Congress-number pair.

name: Congress.gov committee system code
canonical_form: One chamber letter + committee mnemonic + two digits
semantic_validation: Must be looked up in Congress.gov committee history; 00 normally denotes full committee and non-00 a subcommittee.
edge_cases: Codes persist across name history but are controlled, not derivable; commissions/caucuses/task forces complicate assumptions.

name: Congressional Research Service product ID
canonical_form: Controlled alphabetic series prefix + usually five digits
semantic_validation: Lookup in Congress.gov CRS product endpoint; prefix list can grow.
edge_cases: Older product series and withdrawn products exist; do not assume R means the only report type.

name: House/Senate document citation
semantic_validation: Resolve with chamber/Congress/number.
edge_cases: Treaty Docs share a similar number pair but are a separate document type.

name: Congressional hearing serial number
semantic_validation: Resolve with committee/chamber/Congress; prefer GovInfo CHRG package.
edge_cases: Not all hearings have serial numbers; printed serial and GPO jacket ID differ.

name: House communication number
semantic_validation: Require House context and Congress; validate type list.
edge_cases: EC and PM also occur in Senate data; bare type+number is ambiguous.

name: House roll-call vote key
canonical_form: Congress + session + calendar year + roll-call number; human forms usually separate fields
normalization: Store separate congress/session/year/roll fields; do not rely on concatenated display ID.
semantic_validation: Validate against Clerk/Congress.gov vote data.
edge_cases: Congress.gov beta identifier concatenates variable-width roll number after a 3-digit Congress, 1-digit session and 4-digit year; parsing from right is necessary. Non-legislation votes may have different API coverage.

name: Private law number
normalization: Normalize dash and label to Priv. L.
semantic_validation: Resolve against official law collection.
edge_cases: Private-law numbering is separate from public laws; older GovInfo package names can contain irregular separators.

name: Public law number
normalization: Normalize dash to ASCII hyphen and label to Pub. L.
semantic_validation: Congress and law number must resolve in Congress.gov/GovInfo.
edge_cases: OCR may turn en dash into minus/em dash; public and private law numbering are separate.

name: Bioguide ID
issuer: Biographical Directory of the U.S. Congress
semantic_validation: Lookup in Bioguide; do not infer from name.
edge_cases: A member can also have LIS, ICPSR, FEC, GovTrack, Wikidata and social IDs; use maintained crosswalks.

name: Senate LIS member ID
semantic_validation: Lookup in Congress-legislators/Senate data; not every historical member has one.
edge_cases: Shape collides with other letter+6-digit IDs; Senate/member context required.

name: Presidential nomination number
normalization: Remove periods/spaces; uppercase PN; preserve partition.
semantic_validation: Pair with Congress and resolve in Congress.gov.
edge_cases: A base PN query can return all partitions; partitions can follow different confirmation paths; classified nominees may use a D+digits placeholder in nominee-name fields.

name: Congress number
semantic_validation: Check against Congress calendar/coverage.
edge_cases: Congress numbers repeat nowhere, but dates must align.

name: Congressional committee/executive report citation
normalization: Normalize report kind, dash, and part.
semantic_validation: Map H→HRPT, S→SRPT, Ex→ERPT; resolve with Congress and part.
edge_cases: Report parts may be separate granules/packages; Ex. Rept. is Senate executive business.

name: Senate communication number
semantic_validation: Require Senate context and Congress; validate type list.
edge_cases: EC and PM overlap House codes; POM is Senate-specific.

name: Senate roll-call vote key
semantic_validation: Validate against Senate roll-call data.
edge_cases: Vote number restarts each session; human citations may include date rather than Congress.

name: Congressional Serial Set serial number
canonical_form: Integer serial assigned across House/Senate reports and documents
required_context: Require Serial Set or publication metadata.
semantic_validation: Lookup serial-set metadata; distinguish hearing serial numbers.
edge_cases: The word Serial is heavily ambiguous; individual publications also carry Congress/document numbers and sometimes multiple serial volumes.

name: Congressional session number
semantic_validation: Pair with Congress; special sessions/historical sources require lookup.
edge_cases: A session number alone is never globally unique.

name: Treaty document citation
normalization: Normalize label/dash; uppercase optional part suffix.
semantic_validation: Use congressReceived, not necessarily congressConsidered; resolve converted pre-97 numbering through official conversion table.
edge_cases: Treaties remain active across Congresses; pre-97 original numbers were converted; parts A/B/etc. are independently addressable.

name: Congressional Record page citation
normalization: Uppercase section letter; preserve volume/date separately.
required_context: Require Cong. Rec. label or known Record document.
semantic_validation: Require Congressional Record context; validate volume/date/page.
edge_cases: H=House, S=Senate, E=Extensions of Remarks, D=Daily Digest. Page numbers can restart by edition/section and OCR often merges the letter.

name: GAO legal/bid-protest B-number
semantic_validation: Lookup in GAO legal decisions.
edge_cases: A decision may list several related B-numbers separated by commas; dotted suffix identifies related/supplemental matters.

name: GAO report/product number
semantic_validation: Lookup in GAO reports; year and serial length vary.
edge_cases: Historical Comptroller General reports and predecessor agency publications use other series; suffixes such as R occur.

name: GovInfo Congressional Bills package ID
normalization: Uppercase BILLS prefix; lowercase embedded type/version as GovInfo emits.
semantic_validation: Validate bill type/version against controlled lists and dereference package endpoint.
edge_cases: No separators between components after BILLS-; parsing requires longest-known type/code matching.

name: GovInfo Congressional Documents package ID
normalization: Uppercase CDOC prefix; lowercase type; uppercase treaty part suffix if present.
semantic_validation: Dereference package.
edge_cases: Treaty parts and publication suffixes may appear; human treaty identity follows congressReceived.

name: GovInfo Congressional Hearing package ID
normalization: Uppercase CHRG prefix; lowercase document type.
semantic_validation: Dereference package and validate jacket ID/suffix.
edge_cases: Parts, volumes and errata are separate publication variants; jacket IDs can have leading zeros.

name: GovInfo Committee Print package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference package; suffix grammar is collection metadata, not universally numeric.
edge_cases: The tail may be a jacket ID or print number; WPRT and historical forms need lookup.

name: Daily Congressional Record granule ID
normalization: Preserve exact case for Pg token as emitted.
semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo granule.
edge_cases: Sequence suffix disambiguates multiple granules beginning on the same page; it is not a printed pin cite.

name: Daily Congressional Record package ID
semantic_validation: Validate calendar date and GovInfo issue existence.
edge_cases: No issue on every calendar day; package date is publication date, not necessarily legislative day.

name: Bound Congressional Record package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference package.
edge_cases: Bound-edition pagination differs from daily edition; do not equate CREC page IDs with CRECB.

name: Congressional Record Index package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference package.
edge_cases: Index references include page plus date abbreviations such as S1234 [19JA]; those are locators, not separate globally unique IDs.

name: GovInfo Congressional Reports package ID
normalization: Canonicalize type lowercase; preserve suffix order/case as source.
semantic_validation: Dereference package and verify metadata.
edge_cases: Parts, volumes and errata suffixes may coexist; not every human report citation exposes the suffix.

name: GovInfo package ID (generic family)
normalization: Do not globally change case; each collection has its own canonicalization.
semantic_validation: Call /packages/{packageId}/summary and validate collection.
edge_cases: This is only a routing candidate. It deliberately overmatches and must never be treated as a universal semantic validator.

name: GovInfo granule ID (generic family)
canonical_form: Package ID plus collection-specific granule suffix
semantic_validation: Validate only through /packages/{packageId}/granules or granule summary endpoint.
edge_cases: Same lexical shape as package IDs; package/granule distinction is metadata, not reliably regex-detectable.

name: GovInfo Public/Private Law package ID
normalization: Canonical modern form has no separator before number; retain observed legacy raw form.
semantic_validation: Dereference package; ensure class agrees with metadata.
edge_cases: Some legacy private-law packages exhibit a hyphen before the number; accept but do not generate it.

name: GovInfo Congressional Serial Set package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference package.
edge_cases: Individual documents inside serial volumes have more complex IDs; use GovInfo metadata rather than slicing strings.

name: GovInfo Statutes at Large package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo package.
edge_cases: Granules identify pages/acts separately; package is a whole volume.

name: GovInfo U.S. Code granule ID
normalization: Preserve hierarchy tokens; lowercase collection tokens as emitted.
semantic_validation: Dereference granule; do not infer hierarchy solely from string.
edge_cases: Duplicate-anchor suffixes such as -dup2 occur; hierarchy grammar changes by title/document edition.

name: GovInfo U.S. Code title package ID
normalization: Uppercase USCODE prefix; lowercase title token.
semantic_validation: Dereference package and validate edition/title.
edge_cases: Edition year is part of identity; title-level package is not a section ID.

name: Superintendent of Documents classification number
normalization: Preserve spaces, punctuation and case; normalize only with SuDoc authority data.
semantic_validation: Validate against GPO SuDoc class stems/current and historical schedules.
edge_cases: Highly punctuation-sensitive; agency reorganizations create superseded stems; broad regex collides with ordinary section references.

name: Statutes at Large citation
issuer: GPO / Office of the Federal Register
normalization: Normalize Stat. and dash; preserve pin/range.
semantic_validation: Check volume/page exists in Statutes at Large; citation may point to a provision rather than a whole law.
edge_cases: One public law can span many pages; page citations are not enactment identifiers.

name: United States Code citation
issuer: Office of the Law Revision Counsel / GPO
normalization: Normalize reporter to U.S.C.; normalize section symbol but preserve subsection sequence.
semantic_validation: Validate title/section against edition/current code; distinguish positive-law title, uncodified note, appendix, repealed/reserved sections.
edge_cases: Ranges, lists, 'et seq.', Appendix, notes, historical editions and subsection typography require parser logic beyond regex.

name: U.S. Standard General Ledger account number
canonical_form: Six digits in USSGL chart of accounts
semantic_validation: Lookup fiscal-year USSGL chart and account attributes.
edge_cases: Account definitions/validity can change by fiscal year; not a transaction or entity identifier.

name: CFDA number (legacy name for Assistance Listing)
semantic_validation: Lookup Assistance Listings and label as legacy terminology.
edge_cases: The identifier persisted while the catalog was renamed; new alphanumeric program suffixes mean 'CFDA regex' is no longer complete.

name: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN)
normalization: Preserve exactly; uppercase only if issuer specifies.
semantic_validation: Validate in agency/USAspending award data and pair with awarding agency.
edge_cases: There is no government-wide lexical grammar; award numbers can encode program, fiscal year, continuation/supplement and amendment information.

name: Assistance Listing number
canonical_form: Two digits, dot, three alphanumeric characters
semantic_validation: Lookup current/historical Assistance Listing; track effective dates and predecessor CFDA record.
edge_cases: Historically the suffix was numeric (CFDA). Alphanumeric suffixes are valid under the 2025 modernization, so numeric-only validators are now stale.

name: North American Industry Classification System code
canonical_form: 2–6 digits; official U.S. industry codes are six digits, shorter forms are hierarchy levels
normalization: Preserve leading zeros; store edition year.
semantic_validation: Lookup in the applicable NAICS edition and level.
edge_cases: A six-digit code without edition can change meaning over time; generic numeric collision is severe.

name: Product and Service Code (PSC/FSC)
semantic_validation: Lookup current PSC manual and active dates.
edge_cases: Numeric material codes align with Federal Supply Classes; alphabetic service/R&D conventions differ. Generic four-character collision is extreme.

name: Standard Occupational Classification code
semantic_validation: Lookup edition and aggregation/detail level.
edge_cases: Broad/major/minor/detailed occupation codes share shape; codes change between SOC revisions.

name: Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code
required_context: Require CAGE label, SAM/contract context, or registry lookup.
semantic_validation: Lookup in DLA CAGE Search & Inquiry.
edge_cases: Very high collision rate in prose; not every five-character token is CAGE. A company may have multiple CAGE codes for locations.

name: DoDAAC / Federal Activity Address Code (AAC)
semantic_validation: Lookup in DoDAAD/Federal AAC data; distinguish active/deleted records.
edge_cases: All-numeric AACs and agency-defined prefixes occur; six-character shape collides broadly. DoDAAC and civilian AAC share the address-code ecosystem.

name: D‑U‑N‑S number
normalization: Remove separators; left-pad only if verified by source.
semantic_validation: Validate through legacy award/entity data or D&B; no longer the federal entity identifier.
edge_cases: Nine digits collide with SSNs, EINs without separators and many agency numbers; retain as legacy alias, not UEI.

name: DUNS+4
semantic_validation: Validate base DUNS and system context.
edge_cases: The +4 suffix was user-assigned for electronic funds transfer and was not a separate legal entity identifier.

name: NATO Commercial and Government Entity (NCAGE) code
semantic_validation: Lookup in NCAGE/CAGE registry and confirm country.
edge_cases: Lexically identical to CAGE; issuer/country metadata distinguishes them.

name: Unique Entity Identifier (SAM)
normalization: Uppercase; remove spaces only when source labels UEI.
semantic_validation: Lookup SAM entity registration; syntax does not prove issuance.
edge_cases: Random-looking and collides with other 12-character codes; UEI replaced DUNS for federal awards in April 2022.

name: Grants.gov Opportunity ID
canonical_form: Internal Grants.gov identifier, up to platform limits
semantic_validation: Validate through Grants.gov API/record.
edge_cases: Generic shape; must come from OpportunityID field. Do not confuse with Opportunity Number.

name: Grants.gov funding opportunity number
canonical_form: Agency-assigned string, up to Grants.gov field limits
normalization: Preserve exact raw and a case-folded search alias.
semantic_validation: Validate against Grants.gov and issuing agency.
edge_cases: No universal grammar; can include fiscal year, office, program and competition sequence; may be reused only under agency rules.

name: Agency grant/contract award number (generic open class)
normalization: Preserve raw plus issuer and program context.
semantic_validation: Resolve in agency system/USAspending/SAM; classify as PIID or FAIN where possible.
edge_cases: No single federal award-number regex covers procurement and assistance; many apparent formats are program-local.

name: Contract modification number
semantic_validation: Pair with PIID and verify in source award system.
edge_cases: Not globally unique; conventions distinguish unilateral/bilateral/admin actions inconsistently by system.

name: Procurement Instrument Identifier (PIID)
canonical_form: 13–17 alphanumeric characters; common structure AAC + FY + instrument code + serial
normalization: Remove display separators and uppercase; retain raw.
semantic_validation: Apply FAR/agency structure rules, validate AAC, fiscal-year positions, instrument code and source system.
edge_cases: DoD commonly requires exactly 13 characters and excludes I/O in some positions; civilian agencies may use 13–17. Human display often inserts hyphens not present in canonical PIID.

name: Supplementary PIID / order identifier
canonical_form: Base PIID plus agency-defined supplementary identifier
normalization: Store base and supplementary components separately.
semantic_validation: Validate under FAR 4.1602 and agency implementation.
edge_cases: Length/placement varies; a delivery/task order may itself have a standalone PIID and a parent IDV PIID.

name: Solicitation number
normalization: Preserve raw; optionally store dehyphenated alias.
semantic_validation: Validate in SAM/agency procurement system.
edge_cases: No universal grammar; may resemble PIID but can contain more separators/text and can be amended without changing base solicitation.

name: SAM.gov internal opportunity ID
normalization: Lowercase for internal storage if API does.
semantic_validation: Validate via SAM opportunity API.
edge_cases: Generic 128-bit hex shape; only accept from SAM URL/JSON field. It is distinct from solicitation_number.

name: Treasury Agency Identifier (AID)
semantic_validation: Lookup Treasury agency identifier list and effective dates.
edge_cases: Three digits are meaningless without field context; allocation-transfer agency ID is a separate component using the same code list.

name: Agency Location Code (ALC)
canonical_form: Numeric code with length defined by Treasury system/reference data
semantic_validation: Lookup in Treasury ALC master data.
edge_cases: Length varies across legacy/current contexts; do not strip leading zeros or infer agency from prefix without lookup.

name: Business Event Type Code (BETC)
canonical_form: Up to eight uppercase alphanumeric characters in controlled list
semantic_validation: Exact lookup in Treasury BETC reference table; include effective dates.
edge_cases: Regex cannot distinguish a BETC from ordinary short codes; codes can be added/retired.

name: Common Government-wide Accounting Classification agency code (CGAC)
semantic_validation: Lookup current/historical CGAC table.
edge_cases: Organizational reorganizations and independent agencies require effective-date tracking; lexical shape collides with AID/FIPS.

name: Federal Reporting Entity Code (FREC)
semantic_validation: Lookup Treasury FREC reference data.
edge_cases: Not equivalent to CGAC/AID; shape collides with years and account codes.

name: Treasury main account code
semantic_validation: Validate in combination with agency/availability/subaccount.
edge_cases: Not globally unique by itself.

name: Treasury subaccount code
semantic_validation: Validate in complete TAS.
edge_cases: Often 000; not globally unique.

name: Treasury Account Symbol / String TAS
canonical_form: Allocation-transfer agency, agency ID, availability, main account, subaccount components
normalization: Parse into official component fields; preserve source string because separator conventions differ.
semantic_validation: Validate components/effective period against Treasury reference data.
edge_cases: Display 'String TAS' and componentized TAS differ; optional allocation-transfer agency, X/no-year availability, and subaccount notation create many forms.

name: USAspending generated award ID
canonical_form: Platform prefix + source award ID + agency/account discriminator
normalization: Uppercase prefix; otherwise preserve platform value.
semantic_validation: Resolve through USAspending API and retain native PIID/FAIN separately.
edge_cases: Generated IDs are platform joins, not issuer-native legal identifiers; source IDs can contain underscores/hyphens.

name: DFARS case number
semantic_validation: Lookup Defense Acquisition Regulations cases.
edge_cases: Interim/final rules and class deviations have different identifiers.

name: FAR case number
normalization: Uppercase FAR label; preserve zero padding.
semantic_validation: Lookup FAR cases/Federal Register RIN crosswalk.
edge_cases: A FAR case can generate multiple proposed/final/correction documents; case ID is not an FR Doc number or RIN.

name: Federal Acquisition Regulation citation
semantic_validation: Validate against Acquisition.gov/eCFR and current deviation status.
edge_cases: Agency supplements reuse the same numeric scheme with prefixes; clauses have prescriptions and alternates.

name: Agency rulemaking docket number (generic open class)
required_context: Require explicit docket label and issuer.
semantic_validation: Use agency registry/API; no cross-government grammar.
edge_cases: Docket prefixes, year placement, separators and sequence lengths vary by agency and system. Regulations.gov IDs are only one major family.

name: Code of Federal Regulations citation
issuer: GPO / Office of the Federal Register
normalization: Normalize reporter to CFR; store title, part, section and subsection separately.
semantic_validation: Title must be 1–50; validate edition/current eCFR hierarchy and reserved/removed status.
edge_cases: Subparts/appendices/tables and 'et seq.' need parser logic; current eCFR and annual editions are not identical snapshots.

name: Executive Order number
examples: Executive Order 14028 | E.O. 9066 | Exec. Order No. 12333
normalization: Normalize label to Executive Order and integer number.
semantic_validation: Lookup official Presidential Documents/Federal Register disposition tables.
edge_cases: Numbering conventions changed historically; amendments/revocations do not create a new identity for the original order.

name: National security presidential directive identifier
issuer: Executive Office of the President / NSC
examples: NSM-2 | NSPM-7 | PPD-21 | HSPD-12 | NSPD-51 | PDD-63 | NSDD-145
semantic_validation: Validate series, administration and official release/status.
edge_cases: Series restart or change by administration; many directives remain classified or partially released; identical numbers across different prefixes are unrelated.

name: Presidential determination number
normalization: Zero-padding should follow source; normalize label only.
semantic_validation: Lookup Presidential Documents/Federal Register.
edge_cases: Some determinations are unnumbered or published under memorandum titles.

name: Presidential proclamation number
semantic_validation: Lookup official Presidential Documents/Federal Register.
edge_cases: Not every historical proclamation follows the modern numbered series; ceremonial text can mention other proclamation numbers.

name: FederalRegister.gov agency slug
semantic_validation: Lookup API agency endpoint; names and organizational history change.
edge_cases: Generic slug shape; only meaningful in FederalRegister.gov fields/URLs.

name: Federal Register citation
issuer: Office of the Federal Register / GPO
normalization: Normalize reporter to FR and remove page commas; preserve range.
semantic_validation: Validate volume/page/date through FederalRegister.gov or GovInfo.
edge_cases: A page cite identifies the start/pin of a document, not the document's stable FR Doc number; annual volume resets.

name: Federal Register document number
normalization: Uppercase letter prefixes; preserve zero padding.
semantic_validation: Authoritative lookup by document_number; do not validate only by year/length.
edge_cases: Legacy electronic/prepublication/correction forms coexist; the modern five-digit serial is not universal historically.

name: GovInfo CFR granule ID
canonical_form: CFR package ID plus collection hierarchy tokens
semantic_validation: Dereference granule; hierarchy patterns differ across titles/editions.
edge_cases: Section punctuation is encoded into tokens; appendix/table IDs are irregular.

name: GovInfo CFR volume package ID
semantic_validation: Validate title/volume/year via GovInfo.
edge_cases: A title can span many physical volumes; volume number is publication-specific and not a CFR part.

name: GovInfo Federal Register granule ID
canonical_form: Federal Register document number used as granule ID
semantic_validation: Resolve within the FR issue/package; same lexical family as FR document number.
edge_cases: Package context may be needed where legacy numbers collide.

name: GovInfo Federal Register issue package ID
semantic_validation: Validate issue date in GovInfo.
edge_cases: No issue every calendar day.

name: OMB Circular number
semantic_validation: Lookup current/revised circular and appendices.
edge_cases: Revisions keep the same circular number; appendices/attachments need separate version locators.

name: OMB control number
canonical_form: Four-digit agency family + hyphen + four-digit collection number
semantic_validation: Lookup in OIRA information-collection inventory; check expiration/status.
edge_cases: Lexically collides with RIN fragments, dockets and local case numbers; label/context is required.

name: OMB Information Collection Request reference number
semantic_validation: Validate month, agency/control relationship and lookup in Reginfo.gov.
edge_cases: A control number can have many ICR reference submissions over time.

name: OMB memorandum number
normalization: Uppercase M; preserve displayed zero padding.
semantic_validation: Lookup OMB memorandum archive.
edge_cases: Publication year generally appears in prefix but corrections/rescissions require lifecycle metadata.

name: Daily Compilation of Presidential Documents package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo package.
edge_cases: Year semantics are collection-specific; Weekly Compilation (WCPD) is the predecessor and has a different package grammar.

name: Weekly Compilation of Presidential Documents package ID
semantic_validation: Dereference GovInfo; do not derive semantics from suffix without metadata.
edge_cases: Legacy collection package IDs vary by issue/document granularity.

name: Regulations.gov comment ID
semantic_validation: Resolve API object type; document/comment ID grammars overlap.
edge_cases: Comments can include attached files with separate internal IDs; bulk data may expose IDs not printed in the document.

name: Regulations.gov docket ID
required_context: Docket label or Regulations.gov URL/API context.
semantic_validation: Must be confirmed by Regulations.gov docket endpoint; grammar is agency-defined.
edge_cases: No universal token count; agency/component/office/type/year placement varies. The same prefix can appear in document/comment IDs.

name: Regulations.gov document ID
canonical_form: Usually docket ID + hyphen + item serial
semantic_validation: Resolve API object type; do not infer document versus comment solely from suffix.
edge_cases: Comment IDs often share exactly the same lexical shape; migrated/legacy records can depart from the common docket-plus-serial pattern.

name: Regulations.gov internal object ID
required_context: Only accept in Regulations.gov JSON/URL fields.
semantic_validation: Validate via API metadata; do not treat arbitrary 16-hex strings as Regulations.gov IDs.
edge_cases: Generic hex collision risk is extreme; objectId is a platform key, not the printed agency identifier.

name: Regulations.gov submission tracking key
semantic_validation: Validate only in submission API/workflow.
edge_cases: Opaque and not guaranteed stable as a public citation; broad shape collides with many IDs.

name: Regulation Identifier Number (RIN)
canonical_form: Four digits, hyphen, two letters, two digits
semantic_validation: Lookup in Reginfo.gov; verify agency prefix and title.
edge_cases: RIN normally persists from Unified Agenda through rulemaking stages, but withdrawn/transferred/merged items and reused text references require lifecycle data.

name: Unified Agenda sequence number
semantic_validation: Require agenda edition/agency; never treat as stable cross-edition identity.
edge_cases: Sequence numbers change by edition and are locators, unlike RINs.
